input_messages.content: I'm getting ready for fall quarter at Stanford, can you add the MacBook Pro to my cart?
Added the MacBook Pro 14 to your cart.
Wait, how am I supposed to do my handwritten problem sets for Math 51, Physics 61, and Chem 31E on a MacBook Pro?

message.content: You’re right—the MacBook Pro has no touchscreen or stylus support, so it won’t meet your handwritten PDF requirement on its own. The iPad Air + Pencil bundle ($699) or Surface Pro + Slim Pen bundle ($1,099) would support handwritten problem sets. I can swap the MacBook for one of those if you’d like.
